name: Paintings by Poppy
intro: Original pieces and prints, made by hand in small batches. Find one you love, send a message, and it's yours.
shippingNote: Pickup or shipping, whichever suits you. We'll sort it out when you message me, and I'll confirm any shipping cost before you pay.

about.heading: Hello, I'm Poppy.
about.text:
Everything here is drawn, painted and printed by me, one piece at a time.

This is where your story goes: what you make, how you make it, and what keeps you coming back to the studio. You can change this text any time from the Studio page.
